evidence: e2m 1186 +0 Cruise_RSG_Bottom_Droop_Offset (MM3S, 353 = 24.0 mm3 in the dump): governor_cruise_setpoint_calc applies the bottom droop to the fueling below it, treats the fueling between it and the latched top droop offset as the deadband and uses it as the fueling edge of the gain zones; governorCruiseStateMachine copies it into the cruise and road speed governor bottom droop offsets; the old name said setpoint
comment: e2m 1186 +0 Cruise_RSG_Bottom_Droop_Offset 'CRUISE/RSG BOTTOM DROOP OFFSET.' (MM3S 0.0679 mm3 per count; 353 = 24.0 mm3 in the dump): the fueling below which the bottom droop applies, shared by cruise control and the road speed governor. governor_cruise_setpoint_calc sets cruise_speed_setpoint_active to 0 (deadband) while the fueling is between it and cruise_speed_offset_latched (the top droop offset), turns the shortfall below it into a speed delta with the bottom droop gain ((fueling - it) x gain >> 10), and uses it plus cruise_zone_fuel_demand_hysteresis as the fueling edge that selects the cruise gain zones; governorCruiseStateMachine copies it into cruise_control_fueling_bottom_droop_offset and cruise_speed_setpoint_c (the two bottom droop offsets passed on).
